messages:
marta (PM): quick sync — we need to lock the deprecation timeline for v1 routes and the v2 opt-in window. roadmap email going out next friday, want final dates by EOD tomorrow.
kevin (Eng): +1. can we publish a migration guide before the announcement? engineers will want a clear rollback plan.
sophie (Eng-ML): migration guide should include structured-output schema diffs, function-calling signature changes, and embedding vector shape notes. I'll draft the ML section.
liam (Support): CS asks for at least a 60-day notice for enterprise customers, and a checklist we can share with customers (code samples, SDK steps, opt-in flags).
nora (Customer Success): also flag any customers using custom rerank pipelines — they might need extra time. I'll pull a list.
dave (Infra): rollout-wise: canary -> 10% -> 50% -> full over 4 weeks. we need a compat-mode fallback that auto-routes to v1 if the v2 handler fails schema validation. That needs infra sign-off.
kevin (Eng): compat-mode fallback exists but currently only for text/completions. we need to extend it to embeddings + tool calling. effort estimate: 2sprints for compat adapters + tests.
sophie (Eng-ML): embeddings backward-compat: quantization/float precision differences could change distances. migration guide must show eval regressions and offer mitigations (re-embedding, similarity thresholds).
marta (PM): proposal: public deprecation notice 90 days, 30-day opt-in window for early adopters, 60-day extended window for enterprise with support ticket. Thoughts?
liam (Support): 90 days baseline is fine if we can guarantee a compat fallback. customers will expect a toggle in Console to pause forced cutover.
nora (Customer Success): add a "soft-deprecate" phase where we log v1 usage + send in-console nudge. that helps prioritize who to reach out to.
dave (Infra): we can implement usage telemetry + in-console nudge. infra effort: 1 sprint to add flags + dashboards.
kevin (Eng): launch criteria proposal: (1) compat adapters for completions/embeddings/toolcalls ready, (2) migration guide + SDK examples merged, (3) canary latency/cost within 10% of v1, (4) automated smoke tests + rollback.
sophie (Eng-ML): add eval pass: run our regression suite on a representative customer prompt set and ensure <=2% quality drop or we hold launch.
marta (PM): ok action items: kevin -> compat adapters estimate and plan by EOD; sophie -> eval plan and baseline dataset; dave -> dashboard + toggle ETA; nora/liam -> customer list & comm plan. I'll assemble dates.
kevin (Eng): ETA for adapters: prototype end of next week, full tests in two weeks. I'll break down by route (completions, chat, embeddings, rerank, toolcall).
sophie (Eng-ML): starting eval run today, will share initial regression report in 48h.
dave (Infra): dashboards + toggle: 10 business days. will scope infra risk for automatic fallback (rate of false positives).
liam (Support): we'll draft customer comms: deprecation FAQ, migration checklist, example PRs for SDKs. need internal review.
nora (Customer Success): I'll start outreach to top-20 customers that will likely need extended windows.
marta (PM): decision needed on final deprecation window length. if infra+eng can hit criteria, we go 90 days. if not, extend to 120. can we commit to that contingency?
kevin (Eng): yes, we can plan for 120 as fallback. prefer to aim for 90.
sophie (Eng-ML): note: function-calling schema change can break tool orchestration for a handful of customers. recommend a migration shim in SDKs to map old signatures to new ones.
dave (Infra): shim is safer than per-customer patches. infra will support a short-lived header (X-Compat-Mode: v1) to control behavior.
redwood-ci (bot): Canary deploy started for route-compat-adapter-proto at 2077771200.
kevin (Eng): saw the canary. initial latency looks +6% for chat, embeddings +2%. will optimize kernel selection.
sophie (Eng-ML): run baseline quality checks on canary outputs vs v1, posting results in #eng-ml after CI finishes.
marta (PM): next sync tomorrow 11am to finalize dates. please add any blockers to this thread. thanks all. :thumbsup:
liam (Support): one blocker: docs team bandwidth. need to confirm doc-owner.
kevin (Eng): I'll pair with docs to produce SDK snippets.
nora (Customer Success): I'll coordinate with docs on customer-facing templates.
marta (PM): noted. final note for roadmap blurb: emphasize "migration tooling, compat fallback, extended enterprise window" — avoids surprises.
kevin (Eng): ok. logging action items to the epic and tagging owners.
sophie (Eng-ML): adding the eval thresholds to the launch criteria doc.
marta (PM): great — saving this thread into the roadmap ticket. last reminder: dates by EOD tomorrow.
dave (Infra): logging infra tasks now.
redwood-ci (bot): Canary complete: 2077771800, no crash loops detected.
kevin (Eng): will iterate on perf tomorrow.
marta (PM): thanks team — talk tomorrow.
